feedbackMechanism.howToSendFeedback: Fill up the Customer Feedback Form at the information desk of the office. You can also reach the office on 0960-688-4345, or the contact officers on 0995-469-7747, 0935-818-5300 or 0936-970-0665.
feedbackMechanism.howFeedbackIsProcessed: Feedback is forwarded to the section or person concerned for action. To complain, fill up the Client's Complaint and Feedback Form at the Public Assistance and Complaints Desk. The office evaluates the form, interviews the complainant, and endorses the complaint to the staff concerned or to the Local Civil Registrar, who takes it up with the person complained about and gives feedback.

The two-week publication period and the two to five month PSA affirmation are deliberately not counted in the total. Weeks and months are not units the arithmetic models, and both waits are outside the office: one is the newspaper's, the other the PSA's. Both appear on their steps and are reported as unreadable by the validator.
The charter's requirements block mixes the R.A. 9048 and R.A. 10172 checklists and numbers an item 5 twice. The grouping here is an inference.
